menu:8017980:1.text: To earn big bucks, we need to act fast.
menu:8017980:1.source_cn: 要想赚大钱，必须动作快。

say:1:1423230001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a Sal'thorin merchant just reached out to me through an agent. She's interested in our village specialties.
say:1:1423230001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a Sal'thorin merchant just reached out to me through an agent. She's interested in our village specialties.
say:1:1423230001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a Sal'thorin merchant just reached out to me through an agent. She's interested in our village specialties.

say:2:1423230002:0.text: If things turn out well, we could be landing a major deal!
say:2:1423230002:0.source_cn: 如果合作顺利的话，说不定能成一笔大单子。

say:3:1423230003:0.text: But the Essail still can't travel to the surface at this stage, so she can't inspect the goods herself...
say:3:1423230003:0.source_cn: 但是现在艾塞勒还不能亲自来地表考察……

say:4:1423230004:0.text: Could you make a trip to Sal'thorin and discuss things further with the merchant?
say:4:1423230004:0.source_cn: 希望你能替我跑一趟萨洛克兰，帮我问问那个商人想要点什么物产。
say:4:1423230004:0.male: Could you make a trip to Sal'thorin and discuss things further with the merchant?
say:4:1423230004:0.female: Could you make a trip to Sal'thorin and discuss things further with the merchant?

say:1:1423231001:0.text: Are you here on behalf of Zanie?
say:1:1423231001:0.source_cn: 是祖娅负责人派来的商业联络员吗？
say:1:1423231001:0.male: Are you here on behalf of Zanie?
say:1:1423231001:0.female: Are you here on behalf of Zanie?

say:2:1423231002:0.text: Well, I'm looking for unique plants and seafood from the surface.
say:2:1423231002:0.source_cn: 长话短说吧，我想要点地表特色植物和特色水产！

say:3:1423231003:0.text: I need something no one in Sal'thorin has ever seen or heard of!
say:3:1423231003:0.source_cn: 最好是萨洛克兰的人见都没经过，听都没听过，想象都想象不...

choice_prompt:4:1423231003.text: I need something no one in Sal'thorin has ever seen or heard of!
choice_prompt:4:1423231003.source_cn: 最好是萨洛克兰的人见都没经过，听都没听过，想象都想象不到的新鲜商品！

say:5:1423231004:0.source_cn: 你说的这些我都没听过……

say:6:1423231005:0.text: Alright then, please get me some <style="highlight">aromatic hexaflowers</style>, <style="highlight">ripe glowfly fruits</style>, and <style="highlight">fresh woozy loverfish</style>.

say:7:1423231006:0.text: If I like what I see, there'll be plenty of orders coming your way!
say:7:1423231006:0.source_cn: 如果能让我满意的话，订单肯定是少不了的！
say:7:1423231006:0.male: If I like what I see, there'll be plenty of orders coming your way!
say:7:1423231006:0.female: If I like what I see, there'll be plenty of orders coming your way!

say:8:1423231007:0.text: Make it snappy, though. I need to get ahead of other merchants!
say:8:1423231007:0.source_cn: 记得动作要快，我一定得赶在其他商人进货前抢占商机！
say:8:1423231007:0.male: Make it snappy, though. I need to get ahead of other merchants!
say:8:1423231007:0.female: Make it snappy, though. I need to get ahead of other merchants!

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 六角葵和萤瓤果怎么样？

say:1:1423232001:1.text: Are these the specialties you mentioned?
say:1:1423232001:1.source_cn: 这些就是你说的特殊货物吗？
say:1:1423232001:1.male: Are these the specialties you mentioned?
say:1:1423232001:1.female: Are these the specialties you mentioned?

choice_prompt:2:1423232001.text: Are these the specialties you mentioned?
choice_prompt:2:1423232001.source_cn: 这些就是你说的特殊货物吗？
choice_prompt:2:1423232001.male: Are these the specialties you mentioned?
choice_prompt:2:1423232001.female: Are these the specialties you mentioned?

say:3:1423232002:1.text: Wait, these are hexaflowers and glowfly fruits? I've seen them at the market before! These aren't anything new in Sal'thorin!
say:3:1423232002:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这六角葵和萤瓤果，已经有人在萨洛克兰叫卖了！

say:4:1423232003:1.text: It's not cool to be a copycat.
say:4:1423232003:1.source_cn: 我可不做这种别人做过的生意。

say:5:1423232004:1.text: Now, the woozy loverfish... I think it's great! Not sure how it tastes, but it definitely has a strong market as an ornamental fish.
say:5:1423232004:1.source_cn: 这微醺爱情鱼倒是很不错！味道虽然还不清楚，当成观赏鱼来...

say:6:1423232005:1.text: Are there many fish like this on the surface? Bring me as many different species as you can—I'm sensing huge potential here...
say:6:1423232005:1.source_cn: 地表有很多这样的鱼吗？你帮我多弄些地表不同种类的鱼吧，...
say:6:1423232005:1.male: Are there many fish like this on the surface? Bring me as many different species as you can—I'm sensing huge potential here...
say:6:1423232005:1.female: Are there many fish like this on the surface? Bring me as many different species as you can—I'm sensing huge potential here...

choice_prompt:7:1423232005.text: Are there many fish like this on the surface? Bring me as many different species as you can—I'm sensing huge potential here...
choice_prompt:7:1423232005.source_cn: 地表有很多这样的鱼吗？你帮我多弄些地表不同种类的鱼吧，能弄多少弄多少，说不定还能有别的商机……
choice_prompt:7:1423232005.male: Are there many fish like this on the surface? Bring me as many different species as you can—I'm sensing huge potential here...
choice_prompt:7:1423232005.female: Are there many fish like this on the surface? Bring me as many different species as you can—I'm sensing huge potential here...

say:8:1423232006:1.text: No need to do the fishing yourself this time! Just find a fisherman or a seasoned angler, and you'll get the best catch!
say:8:1423232006:1.source_cn: 哎呀，你别一条一条钓嘛，直接找渔夫或者钓鱼佬收购，他们...
say:8:1423232006:1.male: No need to do the fishing yourself this time! Just find a fisherman or a seasoned angler, and you'll get the best catch!
say:8:1423232006:1.female: No need to do the fishing yourself this time! Just find a fisherman or a seasoned angler, and you'll get the best catch!

choice:7:1:2.text: I can't do this all by myself.
choice:7:1:2.male: I can't do this all by myself.
choice:7:1:2.female: I can't do this all by myself.

choice:2:0:1.text: I have three items with me...
choice:2:0:1.male: I have three items with me...
choice:2:0:1.female: I have three items with me...

say:1:1423233001:0.text: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I was just about to grill some fish for my master. Want one for yourself?
say:1:1423233001:0.male: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I was just about to grill some fish for my master. Want one for yourself?
say:1:1423233001:0.female: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I was just about to grill some fish for my master. Want one for yourself?

choice_prompt:2:1423233001.text: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I was just about to grill some fish for my master. Want one for yourself?
choice_prompt:2:1423233001.source_cn: 是<style=stress><player_name></style>！我正要去给师傅烤鱼呢，你也想来一条吗？
choice_prompt:2:1423233001.male: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I was just about to grill some fish for my master. Want one for yourself?
choice_prompt:2:1423233001.female: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! I was just about to grill some fish for my master. Want one for yourself?

say:3:1423233002:0.text: You've come to the right place! My master and I reeled in a whole load...
say:3:1423233002:0.source_cn: 鲜鱼啊，有的是！我和师傅钓太多了……

say:4:1423233003:0.text: But we've got our hands full at the moment with the grill. I'm afraid you have to look for the fish yourself.
say:4:1423233003:0.source_cn: 不过我们现在都有点腾不开手，要麻烦你找找啦。
say:4:1423233003:0.male: But we've got our hands full at the moment with the grill. I'm afraid you have to look for the fish yourself.
say:4:1423233003:0.female: But we've got our hands full at the moment with the grill. I'm afraid you have to look for the fish yourself.

choice:2:0:1.text: Yes please! I need fresh fish though.
choice:2:0:1.male: Yes please! I need fresh fish though.
choice:2:0:1.female: Yes please! I need fresh fish though.

say:1:1423234001:1.text: Wow, these fish are no doubt exotic...
say:1:1423234001:1.source_cn: 喔！这些鱼，好多都是没见过的品种……

say:2:1423234002:1.text: I need some time to figure out which ones are good for bulk purchase...
say:2:1423234002:1.source_cn: 我要花点时间考察一下哪个适合大批量进货……

say:3:1423234003:1.text: Thanks a lot! This deal wouldn't be possible without you!
say:3:1423234003:1.source_cn: 多谢你了！多亏了你，这生意才能做成！
say:3:1423234003:1.male: Thanks a lot! This deal wouldn't be possible without you!
say:3:1423234003:1.female: Thanks a lot! This deal wouldn't be possible without you!
